heading: This Afternoon
text: Sunny apart from patchy high clouds southeast. Highs from the mid 50s to around 60. North to northeast winds around 5 mph, gusting to 10 mph in the Champlain Valley and St. Lawrence Valleys.

heading: Tonight
text: Increasing high clouds south and east of I-89; mostly clear to the north and west, except increasing clouds late near the international border. Lows from the mid 20s to lower 30s, some mid 30s in the Champlain Valley. Winds becoming light and variable, then northerly 5 to mph late in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Thursday
text: Clouds decreasing south, variable north. Highs in the low to mid 50s north, and mid 50s to lower 60s in the south. North winds gusting to 20 mph, except to 30 mph in the Champlain valley.
